document.content:
# Q3 Widget Launch certification brief

Prepared fictional Launch Control demo content.

Launch code: EP12-DEMO-01. Business app: Launch Control Demo.

## Scope

Supporting work for the partner certification review. This brief is not a certification artifact, an approval, or a substitute for live business records.

## Coordination roles

Partner Review Lead coordinates the evidence review. Launch Coordinator prepares the readiness briefing. Consult the business app for saved assignments and dates.

## Proposed completion signals

An evidence index should list each required artifact, its source link, review state, and unresolved question. A review handoff should identify the reviewer, disposition, and remaining conditions. The readiness briefing should cite the saved review outcome and current launch record.

## Dependencies

Evidence indexing precedes the review handoff. The readiness briefing depends on a recorded review outcome. Until that outcome exists, describe certification as under review, not approved.

## Source of truth

Retrieve live status, blocked work, assignees, due dates, and quality-gate fields from Launch Control Demo. Missing gate fields do not imply approval.
